_comment: Tracks this SDK's relationship to upstream github.com/globus/globus-sdk-python. 'ported' = the upstream version whose API surface this Go module actually implements (bumped ONLY by a human/PR that lands the features; this is the honest parity claim). 'seen' = the latest upstream release the check-upstream-releases workflow has observed and filed an issue for (bumped automatically by CI). When ported != seen there is unported upstream work. Do NOT let automation edit 'ported'.
